responsibility: Holds the V850 RTL machine description: the instruction patterns, expands, splits, attributes, and scheduling reservations that map GCC RTL onto V850 assembly. It defines register-number constants and unspecs, includes the target predicates and constraints, describes moves, arithmetic, branches, calls, prologue/epilogue and interrupt save/restore sequences, and assigns lengths, CPU/type attributes, and long-call behavior so the compiler can recognize, transform, and emit concrete V850 instructions.
same_name_distinction: The declarative RTL machine-description file for the V850 port: unlike v850.cc's C++ hook logic, v850.h's target macros, or v850.opt's option definitions, this file defines the insn patterns, expands, attributes, reservations, and include-based predicate/constraint use that map GCC RTL operations onto concrete V850 instructions.
